parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outside frame of the door set, made of steel, provides structural support and alignment for the door. It is rectangular and surrounds the door panel.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the door in place, ensuring smooth opening and closing while maintaining the door’s alignment and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The main door panel made of wood, rectangular in shape, and attached to the frame. It includes a handle for operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: It can swing or slide depending on the hinge or track mechanism, allowing controlled movement relative to the frame.
